about_the_game:
Boogie Bashers lets you party like there’s no tomorrow. Dance in the spotlight and push others out of it in this goofy, 5 player party game. Steal power ups, avoid hazards, and outsmart your opponents to get more shine than everyone else.

Join the Discord to get some have going and join voice chat! 

This demo contains:

  • Online and Offline modes

  • 2 stages

  • 10 characters

  • 1 game mode (Steal the Spotlight)

  • Keyboard and mouse support

  • Xbox and Playstation style controller support

  • (many other controllers also work)

  • Master volume adjustment

Instructions

Playable with keyboard-n-mouse, Xbox or Playstation style controllers, and most other gamepads.

Menu: Mouse is disabled in menu, use keyboard or gamepad instead. Keyboard uses Enter to select (or start game) and Backspace or Esc to go back. In Character Select the 'T' key toggles between stages, though there is currently no indication.

In-Game: Xbox controllers can use any thumb button (A, B, X, or Y) dance and any shoulder button (RT, LT, RB, or RB) to shove. Keyboard users can use Spacebar to dance and Shift or left-click to shove. The game is first to 7 points. Esc key will exit back to Character Select.

For convenience you can play solo in this build, but the camera is quite bad with only one player. The full release will not allow solo play.
